summary: @or-sdk/deployments preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated math_init.js payload
details: The package advertises itself as a REST client for a Deployments API, but its `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) unconditionally downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from oven-sh's GitHub release, chmods it executable in a temp directory, and then invokes it with the package-local `math_init.js` as its script argument. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line blob obfuscated with a rotating string-array + custom charset decoder (obfuscator.io fingerprints: `WV8StW` shift function over a mixed literal/number array, `hc1jfK9` charset decoder, `_0x`-prefixed identifiers). No readable URLs, endpoints, or purpose strings survive the obfuscation, and the filename `math_init` bears no relation to the package's stated CRUD-over-REST functionality. Running the payload through a freshly-downloaded second runtime routes execution around any tooling that only inspects Node-reachable code, and the opaque bundle can perform arbitrary installer-side actions (credential access, exfiltration, persistence, secondary fetches) with no auditability.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
